num_customers: <int> Number of customers to be served by the supplier.
num_periods: <int> Number of discrete time periods in the planning horizon.
num_vehicles: <int> Number of identical vehicles available for deliveries each period.
vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum total quantity that a single vehicle can carry on one route.
num_nodes: <int> Total number of locations, including the depot (index 0) and all customers.
coordinates: <list[list[int]], shape [num_nodes][2]> X and Y coordinates of each location on a plane.
distance_matrix: <list[list[int]], shape [num_nodes][num_nodes]> Symmetric travel cost between each pair of locations, computed as rounded Euclidean distance.
holding_costs: <list[float], length num_nodes> Per-unit cost charged on inventory remaining at each location at the end of each period.
customer_demands: <list[list[int]], shape [num_customers][num_periods]> Quantity of commodity consumed by each customer in each period.
supplier_production: <list[int], length num_periods> Quantity of commodity produced at the depot in each period.
inventory_capacities: <list[int], length num_nodes> Maximum inventory that can be stored at each location, with index 0 for the depot and the rest for customers.
initial_inventories: <list[int], length num_nodes> Inventory on hand at each location at the start of the planning horizon, with index 0 for the depot and the rest for customers.
